conversations.title: How can I prepare for placements in TCS

messages.content: How can I prepare for placements in TCS and Cisco at SRIT?

To prepare for placements in top-tier companies like **TCS** and **Cisco** at SRIT, you should align your preparation with the standards maintained by our Training & Placement Cell (TPO), headed by **Dr. Vivek Rajput**.

Here is a strategic roadmap for your preparation:

### 1. Understand the Selection Process
*   **TCS:** Typically follows the "TCS NQT" (National Qualifier Test) pattern, which includes Quantitative Aptitude, Verbal Ability, Reasoning, and Programming Logic/Coding. They often hire through both Ninja and Digital profiles.
*   **Cisco:** Cisco generally looks for strong fundamentals in Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA), Computer Networks, Operating Systems, and Database Management Systems (DBMS). They often conduct technical rounds focusing on problem-solving and system design.

### 2. Technical Foundation (The "SRIT Core")
*   **Master Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA):** This is non-negotiable for companies like Cisco. Practice on platforms like LeetCode, HackerRank, or GeeksforGeeks. Focus on Arrays, Linked Lists, Trees, Graphs, and Dynamic Programming.
*   **Core Subjects:** Ensure you have a strong grasp of:
    *   **Computer Networks:** Especially TCP/IP, OSI model, and routing protocols (crucial for Cisco).
    *   **Operating Systems:** Process management, deadlocks, and memory management.
    *   **DBMS:** SQL queries, normalization, and indexing.
*   **Programming Proficiency:** Be highly proficient in at least one language (C++, Java, or Python).

### 3. Leverage SRIT Resources
*   **TPO Guidance:** Stay in touch with the Training & Placement Cell. They organize regular mock interviews, aptitude training sessions, and coding boot camps specifically designed to meet the requirements of recruiters like TCS and Cisco.
*   **Placement History:** Review the placement reports for 2024-25 and 2025-26. With an average package of 5.2 LPA and top packages reaching 44 LPA (National) and 85 LPA (International), the college has a proven track record with these specific companies. Use the TPO's previous year's question banks for practice.
*   **Faculty Mentorship:** Consult your HOD, **Dr. Sachin Sharma (CSE)**, or your subject professors for guidance on advanced technical topics that frequently appear in these companies' technical rounds.

### 4. Soft Skills & Aptitude
*   **Aptitude Training:** TCS places heavy emphasis on aptitude. Dedicate time daily to solving quantitative and logical reasoning problems.
*   **Communication:** Cisco and other MNCs value clear communication. Participate in group discussions and mock interviews conducted by the college to improve your confidence.

### 5. Strategic Tips
*   **Projects:** Build at least one or two high-quality projects (Web Development, AI/ML, or Networking) and host them on GitHub. Be prepared to explain the architecture and challenges faced during these projects in your interviews.
*   **Consistency:** Start your preparation early. Do not wait for the final year. Consistent daily practice is the key to clearing the coding rounds of top recruiters.

**Recommendation:** Visit the **Training & Placement Cell** office to inquire about upcoming specialized training modules or industry-specific workshops scheduled for your batch. They can provide the most current information on the specific hiring criteria for the upcoming recruitment cycle.

what is attendance policy

**Official Attendance Regulations (RGPV Ordinance No. 4 & SRIT Norms)**:

• **Minimum Attendance Required:** Every student must maintain a mandatory minimum of **75% attendance** in each subject (theory and practical sessions).
• **Condonation of Shortage:** A shortage of up to a maximum of **10%** (i.e., attendance between 65% and 75%) may be condoned by the **Principal / Director** strictly on genuine medical grounds (supported by medical certificates submitted within prescribed timelines) or authorized participation in university-level sports/cultural events.
• **If your attendance is 70%:** You have a 5% shortage. You **cannot** automatically appear in end-semester examinations. However, since 70% is above the 65% threshold, you may submit valid medical proof to the Principal's office. If the Principal approves medical condonation, you will be permitted to sit for the exams. If unapproved, you will be detained.
• **Attendance below 65%:** Strict detention. Attendance shortage below 65% cannot be condoned under any circumstances, and the student is barred from appearing in semester exams.

messages.content: Tell me about the cricket one

The cricket initiative at SRIT is the **Engineering Premier League (EPL)**. Here are the key details:

### **Overview**
The **Engineering Premier League (EPL)** is SRIT's premier annual cricket tournament and championship. It is one of the most prominent sporting events in the Mahakoshal region, bringing together students from various engineering branches (B.Tech, M.Tech) and colleges.

---

### **Key Highlights & Features**
* **Professional Match Setup:** Features dedicated college cricket grounds, professional pitches, certified umpire officiating, live scoring, and commentary.
* **Recognition & Awards:** Trophies for winning teams, runners-up, along with individual awards such as Player of the Match, Best Batsman, Best Bowler, and Player of the Tournament.
* **Tournaments:** Organizes both inter-branch competitions and inter-collegiate tournaments in tennis-ball and leather-ball formats.

---

### **Key Activities**
* **Annual EPL Tournament:** The flagship championship event.
* **Inter-Branch Leagues:** Friendly yet competitive matches between departments (CSE, ME, Civil, EC, etc.).
* **Selection Trials:** Regular trials to select the official SRIT College Cricket Team for university (RGPV) and regional sports meets.
* **Net Practice Sessions:** Regular training and practice sessions on the college ground.

---

### **Eligibility & How to Join**
* **Eligibility:** Open to all registered SRIT students across all years and branches.
* **Contact:** You can get involved by connecting with the **Sports Officer / Faculty Coordinator in the Physical Education Department** on campus.

knowledge.title: First College Established under Shri Ram Group
knowledge.content: The very first college established under the Shri Ram Group was Shri Ram Institute of Technology (SRIT), founded in 2001. Following the establishment of SRIT in 2001, the group expanded by establishing Shri Ram Institute of Pharmacy (SRIP in 2003), Shri Ram Institute of Technology - MCA (2004), Shri Ram Commerce College (2005), Shri Ram Institute of Management / MBA (2005), Shri Ram Institute of Science & Technology (SRIST in 2007), and Shri Ram College of Law (2008).

knowledge.title: Difference Between Shri Ram Group and SRIT
knowledge.content: Shri Ram Group is the overall parent educational group established on 9 July 2001, comprising multiple constituent institutes educating over 10,000+ students across engineering, pharmacy, commerce, computer applications, management, and law. Shri Ram Institute of Technology (SRIT) is specifically the flagship engineering and technology institute founded in 2001 within the group, offering B.Tech, M.Tech, MCA, and MBA degrees affiliated with RGPV Bhopal.

knowledge.title: Difference Between SRIT and Shri Ram College / Commerce College
knowledge.content: Shri Ram Institute of Technology (SRIT) is an AICTE-approved engineering and technology institute established in 2001, affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya (RGPV), Bhopal for technical degrees (B.Tech, M.Tech, MCA). Shri Ram College / Shri Ram Commerce College is a separate constituent college established in 2005, affiliated with Rani Durgavati Vishwavidyalaya (RDVV), Jabalpur, offering non-technical and professional commerce degrees including B.Com, BBA, BCA, and M.Com.

knowledge.title: University Affiliations across Shri Ram Institutions (RGPV vs RDVV)
knowledge.content:
1. Technical Programs (B.Tech, M.Tech, MCA, B.Pharm) at SRIT, SRIST, and SRIP are affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya (RGPV), Bhopal.
2. Commerce, Humanities, and General Degree Programs (B.Com, BBA, BCA, M.Com) at Shri Ram Commerce College (Shri Ram College) are affiliated with Rani Durgavati Vishwavidyalaya (RDVV), Jabalpur.
3. Law Programs (LL.B, B.A. LL.B) at Shri Ram College of Law are affiliated with RDVV Jabalpur and approved by the Bar Council of India (BCI).
4. MBA is affiliated with RDVV Jabalpur / RGPV and approved by AICTE.

knowledge.title: Attendance Requirements & Condonation Rules (75% Minimum)
knowledge.content: Under RGPV Ordinance No. 4 and institutional academic regulations, every student must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in theory and practical sessions for each subject. A shortage up to a maximum of 10% (between 65% and 75%) may be condoned by the Principal / Director strictly on genuine medical grounds (supported by medical certificates submitted within prescribed timelines) or authorized representation in university sports/cultural events. Students with attendance below 65% are strictly ineligible for condonation and are detained from appearing in end-semester university examinations.

knowledge.title: Subjects in First Year B.Tech (RGPV Scheme)
knowledge.content:
In the first year of B.Tech under the RGPV AICTE Flexible Curricula / Grading System (CBGS), students are divided into Group A (Chemistry Group) and Group B (Physics Group). Across the full first year, there are 10 core subjects (5 per semester):

Group A:
1. BT101 Engineering Chemistry (4 credits, theory + lab)
2. BT102 Mathematics-I (4 credits, theory)
3. BT103 English for Communication (3 credits, theory + lab)
4. BT104 Basic Electrical & Electronics Engineering (4 credits, theory + lab)
5. BT105 Engineering Graphics (3 credits, theory + lab)

Group B:
1. BT201 Engineering Physics (4 credits, theory + lab)
2. BT202 Mathematics-II (4 credits, theory)
3. BT203 Basic Mechanical Engineering (4 credits, theory + lab)
4. BT204 Basic Civil Engineering & Mechanics (4 credits, theory + lab)
5. BT205 Basic Computer Engineering (3 credits, theory + lab)

knowledge.title: Subjects in 3rd Semester Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)
knowledge.content:
According to the current RGPV Scheme for B.Tech CSE (3rd Semester), there are 5 core subjects:
1. CS301 - Energy & Environmental Engineering (3 credits)
2. CS302 - Discrete Structure (4 credits)
3. CS303 - Data Structures (4 credits, with Practical Lab)
4. CS304 - Digital Systems (4 credits, with Practical Lab)
5. CS305 - Object Oriented Programming & Methodology (OOPM in Java/C++) (4 credits, with Practical Lab)
Plus Java / Skill Development Laboratory sessions.

knowledge.title: Subjects in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AI/ML)
knowledge.content:
In the AI/ML branch under RGPV, 3rd semester subjects include:
1. AL301 Energy & Environmental Engineering (3 credits)
2. AL302 Discrete Mathematics (4 credits)
3. AL303 Data Structures & Algorithms (4 credits, with lab)
4. AL304 Object Oriented Programming using Python (4 credits, with lab)
5. AL305 Introduction to Artificial Intelligence (4 credits, with lab)
In 4th semester: Machine Learning (AL402), Database Systems (AL403), Operating Systems (AL404), and Design & Analysis of Algorithms (AL405).

knowledge.title: Placement Records & Highest Package (85 LPA International / 44 LPA National)
knowledge.content: Shri Ram Institute of Technology (SRIT) recorded a highest international placement offer of 85 LPA and top-tier national packages of 44 LPA. The overall average package ranges between 4.8 LPA and 5.2 LPA. Over 120 recruiters participate in campus hiring including TCS, Persistent Systems, Infosys, Cisco, Cognizant, Hexaware, Jio, Amdocs, and Capgemini, achieving an approximate 85% placement rate for eligible students. In accordance with student data privacy regulations, official placement bulletins do not publish individual personal student names.

knowledge.title: About Shri Ram Institute of Technology (SRIT)
knowledge.content: Shri Ram Institute of Technology (SRIT) is one of the premier engineering and professional educational institutions in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh. Founded under the aegis of the Shri Ram Group, the institute provides quality higher education in engineering, technology, computer applications, and management. SRIT is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi, and is affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya (RGPV), Bhopal for engineering programs, and Rani Durgavati Vishwavidyalaya (RDVV), Jabalpur for management and computer applications.

knowledge.title: History & Establishment of Shri Ram Group and SRIT
knowledge.content: Shri Ram Group officially came into existence on 9 July 2001. Shri Ram Institute of Technology (SRIT) was established in 2001 as its pioneer engineering institution in Jabalpur, under the academic leadership of space scientist Dr. S. P. Kosta (former Deputy Director of ISRO Aryabhata project). Over two decades, the group expanded into a premier multi-disciplinary campus with institutions in Engineering (SRIT, SRIST), Pharmacy (SRIP), MCA, and Management.

knowledge.title: Founder, Ownership & Governance of SRIT

The institute is governed by its officially appointed Governing Body and Board of Governors in accordance with AICTE and RGPV regulatory guidelines. knowledge.title: SRIT Location & Campus Address
knowledge.content: SRIT is located at Near I.T.I, Madhotal, Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh - 482002, India. The campus is well-connected to Jabalpur Railway Station (approx. 8 km) and Jabalpur Airport (approx. 20 km), with dedicated college bus transit routes across the city.

knowledge.title: Courses & Programs Available at SRIT
knowledge.content: SRIT offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma degrees: 1. Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) - 4-year degree. 2. Master of Technology (M.Tech) - 2-year post-graduate degree in specialized engineering domains. 3. Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - professional software degree. 4. Master of Business Administration (MBA) - postgraduate management degree.

knowledge.title: B.Tech Branches at SRIT
knowledge.content: The B.Tech program offers specialization across major engineering disciplines: 1. Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) 2. Computer Science & Engineering - Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (CSE - AI & ML) 3. Computer Science & Engineering - Data Science (CSE - DS) 4. Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE) 5. Electrical Engineering (EE) 6. Mechanical Engineering (ME) 7. Civil Engineering (CE). All engineering programs follow the RGPV curriculum enriched with practical lab sessions, industry projects, and emerging technology electives.

knowledge.title: Admission Process & Eligibility
knowledge.content: Admissions to B.Tech are conducted primarily through the MP DTE (Directorate of Technical Education, Madhya Pradesh) centralized online counseling, based on JEE Main scores and 10+2 qualifying marks (minimum 45% aggregate in Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Computer Science/Biology for General category, and 40% for reserved categories). Direct college-level counseling (CLC) is also conducted as per DTE guidelines for vacant seats. Candidates for MCA require a recognized Bachelor degree with Mathematics at 10+2 or graduation level.

knowledge.content: Official College Contacts: Phone Helplines: +91 9755042292, +91 9755042293, 0761-4001933 / 36. Email: info@sritgroup.net. knowledge.title: Campus Infrastructure & Facilities
knowledge.content: SRIT features a sprawling 30+ acre green campus with state-of-the-art facilities: 1. Central Library with more than 50,000 books, national & international journals, DELNET access, and digital library e-resources. 2. High-tech Computer Centers equipped with high-speed internet, modern workstations, and licensed software. 3. Well-equipped Departmental Laboratories & Mechanical Workshops. 4. Large Multi-purpose Auditorium and air-conditioned Seminar Halls with modern audio-visual systems. 5. College Canteen and cafeteria serving hygienic food and refreshments. 6. Fleet of 50+ college buses connecting all corners of Jabalpur and nearby regions. 7. Medical room with first-aid and visiting doctor. 8. Wi-Fi enabled academic blocks.

knowledge.title: Sports Facilities & Athletic Complex
knowledge.content: SRIT provides extensive sports facilities encouraging physical fitness and teamwork: dedicated Cricket ground (host to the renowned Engineering Premier League - EPL), Football field, Volleyball courts, Basketball court, Badminton courts, and indoor sports facilities including Table Tennis, Chess, and Carrom. Annual sports meets and inter-collegiate tournaments are held regularly.

knowledge.title: Engineering Premier League (EPL) - Cricket Tournament
knowledge.content: EPL stands for Engineering Premier League. It is the premier annual cricket tournament hosted by Shri Ram Institute of Technology (SRIT) in Jabalpur. The tournament brings together B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, and professional students from various engineering branches and colleges across the Mahakoshal region. It features professional cricket pitches, umpire officiating, trophies, player-of-the-match awards, and enthusiastic student participation.

knowledge.title: Occulus - SRIT Rock Band & Music Society
knowledge.content: Occulus is the official Battle of Rock Bands and music society of Shri Ram Institute of Technology (SRIT) Jabalpur. Founded and run by enthusiastic student musicians, Occulus provides a platform for vocalists, guitarists, drummers, and keyboardists to perform and collaborate. The Occulus band performs live during college fests, sports inaugurations, NCC parades, and inter-collegiate cultural festivals.

knowledge.title: Vahini - Women Empowerment Forum
knowledge.content: Vahini is the dedicated Women Empowerment Initiative launched by Shri Ram Institute of Technology under the mentorship of senior faculty including Mrs. Mona Jain. Vahini unites female students, faculty members, and staff to promote gender sensitization, leadership, self-defense workshops, health awareness drives, career mentorship, and social outreach for underprivileged girl children.

knowledge.title: Dance Club (SRIT Rhythm)
knowledge.content: The Dance Club at SRIT coordinates dance enthusiasts across Classical, Western, Contemporary, Hip-Hop, and Folk styles. Members rehearse regularly and represent SRIT at university youth festivals, annual social gatherings, and state-level dance battles.

knowledge.title: Training & Placement Cell (T&P) Activities
knowledge.content: The Training and Placement (T&P) Cell at SRIT works actively to prepare students for campus recruitment. T&P activities include: 1. Quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, and verbal ability training. 2. Technical mock interviews and coding assessments. 3. Soft skills and group discussion grooming sessions. 4. Campus recruitment drives by leading IT and core engineering companies. 5. Industry interaction, expert lectures, and summer internship coordination.

knowledge.title: Activities for First-Year Students
knowledge.content: First-year students at SRIT (including B.Tech AIML, CSE, DS, and other branches) can participate in a wide array of activities: 1. Join student clubs such as Occulus (Music), Dance Club, Sports Club, and Vahini. 2. Participate in the annual EPL Cricket tournament trials and sports meets. 3. Attend technical coding bootcamps, AI/ML workshops, and robotics demonstrations. 4. Compete in TechFest events (quiz, paper presentation, coding competitions). 5. Take part in National Service Scheme (NSS), blood donation camps, and campus green drives.

knowledge.title: AIML Student Guide & Opportunities at SRIT
knowledge.content: For B.Tech students specializing in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AIML): SRIT provides dedicated AI/ML computing labs with GPU acceleration, Python & Data Science environments, and machine learning toolkits. AIML students are encouraged to participate in coding hackathons, the Technical Club, AI project exhibitions at TechFest, and T&P technical upskilling workshops.

persons.biography: Er. R. K. Karsoliya is the Founder Chairman of Shri Ram Group, Jabalpur. persons.title: Dr.
persons.qualifications: Ph.D., Renowned Indian Space Scientist & Technocrat
persons.biography: Dr. Shiv Prasad Kosta is an eminent Indian space scientist, educationist, and technocrat. Born in Garha, Jabalpur, he served in distinguished national scientific roles before guiding the academic establishment of Shri Ram Group in 2001. At ISRO, he served as Deputy Director for India’s historic first satellite project, Aryabhata, and as Group Director at the ISRO Satellite Centre in Bangalore, collaborating with Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam and former CEC T. N. Seshan. He served as Director in the Department of Electronics (now MeitY, Govt of India) from 1987 to 1990, Vice-Chancellor of Jabalpur University (Rani Durgavati Vishwavidyalaya) from 1990 to 1994, and Director General of M.M. Vedic University until 2000. He is documented across official college records as Group Director / Director General leading the academic and institutional vision of the Shri Ram Group.
persons.experience: Deputy Director for ISRO Aryabhata Satellite Project; Group Director at ISRO Satellite Centre; Director at Department of Electronics (Govt of India, 1987-1990); Vice-Chancellor of Jabalpur University (1990-1994); Director General of M.M. Vedic University (until 2000); Group Director of Shri Ram Group (2001-present). Author of ~10 books on Indian satellites and space missions.
persons.achievements: Key leader in launching India’s first satellite Aryabhata; pioneer of engineering education in Mahakoshal region; authored ~10 books on satellite communications and electronics.
persons.source: Official Shri Ram Group Website (Group Director Message) & Scientific Bio Records
